title: pane.send
description: Types text into a pane's program as it is, through the pane's input queue. Text over 4096 bytes is refused, not cut. A pane takes at most 20 sends a second: one more is refused as rate limited, as is a send when the pane's input queue is full. A protected pane refuses a send with the error "the pane is protected: <reason>", where the reason is ssh, sudo, root, echo-off, marked or rule, never the command line: its foreground process is ssh, mosh, sudo, su or doas, runs as root, has echo off for a password, matches a configured command-line pattern or cannot be read, or the person marked the pane. A send to a pane other than the caller's own goes a line at a time: the first line now, and each next one about 150 ms later if the pane is still unprotected, so text that starts ssh cannot type into it. A later line the check stops is dropped with the rest, after the reply. Such a send is refused while the pane still has lines of an earlier one to go. Needs hello version 2, and for now the pane must be the caller's own (the self scope), which is never split.

pane.description: The pane's number, which must be the caller's own.

text.description: At most 4096 bytes of UTF-8. It runs a command only if it carries the line end the program expects.

lines.description: Only for a send to another pane: how many lines the text has. The first was queued; later ones may still be dropped if the pane becomes protected.
